description: This script generates reStructuredText documentation files for examples of PyTorch models, including source code snippets and exported computation graphs, using the torch export and dynamo modules.

methods.name: generate_example_rst
methods.description: Generates a reStructuredText (.rst) documentation file for a given ExportCase, including source code and exported graph.

methods.name: generate_index_rst
methods.description: Creates an index.rst file summarizing all examples grouped by support level and tags.

methods.name: generate_tag_rst
methods.description: Creates individual .rst files for each tag, listing all examples associated with that tag.

methods.name: generate_rst
methods.description: Main function to generate all documentation files, organizing examples by tags and support levels.
